description: The third candidate set of September 2026: the packages of dpp-release-2026-09-2 with the complete export of the index (GET /evidence-export, parts over one snapshot bounded by states and bytes, resumed by cursor, joined by the reader; contracts/evidence-export.schema.json and contracts/overlay.yaml 0.7.0-draft) and the selected-claim qualification of the ledger (conformance/qualify.mjs). @bsv/dpp-overlay-topics moves to 0.4.0; @bsv/dpp-core 0.3.0, @bsv/dpp-profiles 0.3.0 and @bsv/vsc 0.2.0 are unchanged. Wire formats, the custody profile and the runtime baseline are those of the first set. Candidate until the packages are published under the versions named here.

dependencies.name: mongodb
dependencies.note: the reference persistence of the index node, replaceable

dependencies.name: @bsv/wallet-toolbox-client
dependencies.note: the application service's wallet, not a dependency of any package here

packages.name: @bsv/dpp-core
packages.role: the record model (both versions), signatures, chain verification, the verification report, the native claim, the generic anchor, the managed acceptance record, publisher policy and evidence packages

support.notes: Depends on @bsv/sdk only and imports no Node built-in; a browser bundle is not tested and not promised.

packages.name: @bsv/dpp-overlay-topics
packages.role: the topic managers, lookup services, storage adapters, capabilities, history, bounded export, complete export, retraction and synchronisation of the index, as a library; the node itself ships as the image

support.notes: Server only: Node built-ins, the overlay engine and the MongoDB driver. Importing never starts the HTTP host, which is reached by path as dist/index.js.

packages.name: @bsv/dpp-profiles
packages.role: the industry, exchange and operator profiles as frozen manifests with generated schemas and consumer documents, the lifecycle mapping for both record versions, and the GS1 identifier helpers; the GS1 discovery helpers, the interoperability manifests, the shared evidence shapes, the declarative applicability evaluator and the deterministic passport projection

support.notes: Reads its data files through the Node file system; the one runtime dependency is the RFC 8785 canonicaliser.
The manifest, identity, exchange, operator and interoperability schemas and the pinned GS1 resolver schemas.
Generated payload schemas, consumer documents and mapping inventories.
The digests every published file is held to.

packages.name: @bsv/vsc
packages.role: the VSC draft compatibility profile with its owned context and schema artefacts and the two proof suites; the EPCIS source helpers with the pinned EPCIS 2.0.1 artefacts (./epcis-source) and the external ecdsa-rdfc-2019 credential verifier (./exchange)

support.notes: Server only: reads its artefacts through the file system and decompresses status lists with node:zlib.
The external ecdsa-rdfc-2019 credential verifier; server only for the same reasons.
The EPCIS source helpers; server only for the same reasons.
The owned context and schemas, the pinned EPCIS and W3C artefacts and the external passport context and schema, each with a notice file naming its digest.

alsoSupported: owner-signed transfer (spec/custody.md section 4) for version 1 lineages

serviceInterface.note: PassportService in the application repository is the account-agnostic entry point over the writer's journal; it consumes the packages above and is not itself published in this set.

artefacts.pins: the baseline this set claims, with every fixture digest
the report schema and reason codes
the shared evidence, measurement, certification, document and language shapes

consumers.name: bsv-blockchain-demos/dpp-app
consumers.consumes: verbatim mirrors of packages/dpp-core, packages/overlay-topics, packages/dpp-profiles and packages/vsc pinned by blob hash (packages/STANDARD_MIRROR.json), to be replaced by the published packages of this set
consumers.note: the example consumer with the sector workflows

consumers.name: bsv-blockchain-demos/uora-bsv
consumers.consumes: the four packages as vendored tarballs, to be replaced by the published packages of this set
